_doc: Cell shapes and the multi-cell pieces built from them (docs/CONTENT.md 4d). shapes: id -> the solid polygon in cell-local coordinates (0..1, x right, y down), convex, clockwise on screen. A cell's rotation (quarter turns clockwise, about the cell centre) and mirror (x flipped before turning) are stored next to its shape on the grid; scripts/ship/shapes.gd does the maths. tri at rotation 0 is the bottom-left half (the diagonal runs from the top-left corner to the bottom-right). round2: the quarter disk centred at the piece's bottom-right corner (2,2), radius 2, as an 8-segment polygon, clipped to each of its 4 cells. pieces: id -> cells as {off: [x, y] in the piece, shape}. At rotation 0 a piece is as listed: slope2 is 2x1 and rises from (0,1) to (2,0) across its two cells, solid below the line; round2 is 2x2. Pieces turn in quarter turns and can be mirrored; the anchor is the top-left cell of the turned footprint, like components.
